mapper.select: SELECT id, tenant_id, task_id, instance_id, node_key, task_name, assignee_id, assignee_name, create_time_task, claim_time, complete_time, wait_duration, handle_duration, total_duration, status, action, create_time, update_time FROM wf_task_monitor WHERE task_id = #{taskId}

SELECT id, tenant_id, task_id, instance_id, node_key, task_name, assignee_id, assignee_name, create_time_task, claim_time, complete_time, wait_duration, handle_duration, total_duration, status, action, create_time, update_time FROM wf_task_monitor WHERE instance_id = #{instanceId} ORDER BY create_time_task ASC

SELECT id, tenant_id, task_id, instance_id, node_key, task_name, assignee_id, assignee_name, create_time_task, claim_time, complete_time, wait_duration, handle_duration, total_duration, status, action, create_time, update_time FROM wf_task_monitor WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND assignee_id = #{assigneeId} ORDER BY create_time_task DESC

SELECT id, tenant_id, task_id, instance_id, node_key, task_name, assignee_id, assignee_name, create_time_task, claim_time, complete_time, wait_duration, handle_duration, total_duration, status, action, create_time, update_time FROM wf_task_monitor WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND status IN ('PENDING', 'CLAIMED') AND TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, create_time_task, NOW()) * 1000 > #{threshold} ORDER BY create_time_task ASC
